description:
The charter spec's schema-enforcement table (Section 3,
_project/specs/uat-framework.md:355-368) claims at least 7 load-time
validations that do not exist -- two verified empirically on develop @
fc31f3604 by loading configs through validate_config:
`scales: {rungs: [0.01, 0.1], override: 1.0}` is ACCEPTED (spec says
error) and `validator_clean_rate_floor: 1.5` is ACCEPTED (spec says
error). Also runtime-only: package.submit_terminal_state vocabulary +
service-required checks live in package.py:56-68 not config.py; not
enforced anywhere: cross_scale_coverage_min_pairs-without-report,
preflight-fields-without-preflight warning. Silent coercions:
phases_arg: [load] str()-coerces to "['load']" (config.py:311);
rungs: [true] passes as 1.0; output.* templates str()-coerce mappings.
phases: order and duplicates are unvalidated (config.py:175-185) --
`phases: [report, execute]` produced an empty report pre-
uat-fail-advance-consistency; duplicates run a phase twice.

Enumeration gap: resolve_platforms appends `include` entries WITHOUT
registry validation (matrix.py:153-156) -- a retired platform in a
frozen shard surfaces only at execute time (benchmark includes get
visible pruned-accounting rows, enumerate.py:106-117; platforms should
match). All 32 configs currently load and enumerate non-empty (verified
by running the loader 2026-07-10), but nothing guards this: zero tests
reference the 18 generated shards. The frozen-config-replay blind spot's
suggested guard was never added.

Lifecycle-policy drift: 9 of 15 top-level configs carry neither
# TEMPLATE nor # HISTORICAL headers despite the Section 9 policy;
docs/operations/uat-framework.md:21 tells operators to run the
HISTORICAL config that :310-313 forbids re-running.

SPEC REALIGNMENT (after the code changes above land, rewrite the stale
sections in one pass): Section 1.4 still declares throughput out of
scope (tests/uat/throughput.py shipped 2026-07-10); Section 2 module
table omits artifact_hygiene/container_cleanup/throughput and carries a
stale ~6,500 LOC budget (actual ~7,957 pre-batch -- re-measure at
realignment time); Section 3 schema table must match the NOW-implemented
validations and document fields code enforces but the spec omits
(local_platforms_check, benchmark_runs_dir_template, extra_args,
official/streams/seed, release_gate_runtime_envelopes); Section 4 make-
target args are stale for uat-validate/report/explorer-smoke/package and
omit uat-artifact-hygiene/bring-up/docker-cleanup (+ gate-check once
landed); Section 4's description of test_no_cli_surface_drift.py claims
it "fails on submit signature drift" while the guard now allowlists ~28
CLI files and SKIPS submit.py/run.py signature checks
(test_no_cli_surface_drift.py:50-66) -- describe the real guarantee;
Section 6 documents a 9-column TSV (actual: 12+, REPORT_HEADER
report.py:53-58) and a parity test that "matches row count" (actual:
header-only, test_replay_2026_05_02.py:25); Section 2:133/3:313 claim
draft-pr/merged-to-published-results open PRs (stubs, package.py:34,
:126-132 -- either document as unimplemented or remove from the vocab);
resume sections already scrubbed by uat-resume-retirement.
